system.description: A hobgoblin king and 1d4 bodyguards live in the hobgoblin lair. The king has 22 hit points and fights as a 5 Hit Dice monster, gaining a bonus of +2 on damage rolls. The bodyguards all fight as 4 Hit Dice monsters and have 3d6 hit points each. As long as their king is alive and with them, hobgoblin morale is 10 rather than 8. A hobgoblin king might have one or more thouls in his bodyguard as well (see Thoul). There can be hobgoblin spellcasters; see "Monster Spellcasters" later in this chapter. Terrain: Cavern, Hill, Mountain, Woods.
system.special: <p><p>&lt;p&gt;There can be hobgoblin spellcasters; see "Monster Spellcasters" later in this chapter.&lt;/p&gt;</p></p>
